N.A. Veer shaivachar kaustuuva वीरशैवाचारकौस्तुभः Sanskrit Handwritten on paper N.A 25 (398 Sloka) 13.5"x 8.4" Incomplete
(p.1)
oṃ ।। vīraśaivācārakaustubhaḥ ।।
(p.2) śrīvīraśaivadharmasya likhyate kaustubho mayā। tadācāraikaniṣṭhānāṃ prasādāya mahātmanām ।। 1 ।।
śrīmajjaṅgamarūpiṇekhilajagatsaṃrakṣansaṇodyogine śrīvedāntavacovilāsaracanā saṃvedya cinmūrttaye ।। śrīvīravrataniṣṭhabhaktahṛdayāmbhojātasanmaṇṭape saṃlakṣyāya namo namostu satataṃ liṅgāya cicjyotiṣe ।। 2 ।।
mūrtiryasya viśuddhasatvavimalā kundenduhīropamā vāmāṅgīkṛtayoṣidānatajagachreyo vidhānotsuka ।। jāyāpuṇyaviśeṣavaibhavavatāṃ cetaḥ prasādoccayai rdhātrījanmajarāvimocanamumākāntassa me bhāsatām ।। 3 ।।
yā māyā prakṛtistribhirnijaguṇairdīptāpyamistraimithai (rścai)tanyapratibimbaḍambaravaśādviśvātmatā dṛśyate ।। asmākaṃ vitarītarītusakalāṃ sampattimavyāhatā munmīlatkaruṇāṃ taraṅgitadṛśā līlāñcitā sā śivā ।। 4 ।।
tanyāsāmativelabhaktikalanā svādhīnagaṅgādharā sphārāvārakṛpāsamudralaharī kallolamālāplutai ।। sākṣādīśamukhodgamāgamamataprakhyāpanādeśikā vasmākaṃ sthirabhaktibhāgyakaṇikāṃ nandīśabhṛṅgīśvarau ।। 5 ।।
śambhorunmiṣadatyamarṣapiśunā sphārasphuradrājaso। drekākārabhayaṃ karonnatatanurvīrāśriyā vāsabhūḥ ।। dṛpyaddurjanasaṅgatarjanavidhe dhīrāraveṇaivayo nirvoḍhā mama virabhadragaṇarāḍvighnānvighnantu naḥ ।। 6 ।।
(p.3) dattāmuttamabuddhikauśalabalaṃ velātimāmnāya bhū। viśrāntākhilaśaivatatvasaraṇiṃ satkāmikādyāgamaiḥ ।। vyaktāpañcamukhodgataistanukṛtāṃ devyā ca yaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ। śiṣyānbodhayatisphuṭaṃ tanukarotyaktārtha dārḍhyāya(bi) ।। 7 ।।
citte bhittau samastā naḥ haraharamalāncitraye citrarūpān। bhāsvatkailāsaśṛṅge bhavanavacaraṇadvandvayordvandvavarjam ।। sevāmevātmabhāvātiśayitamanasā kurvataṃ sārvakālaṃ। sarvābhīṣṭārthadānātpra{ṇa}matavidasāngaṇeśānanaṃ tān ।। 8 ।।
bhūmau bijjaḻaśāmbarīmatitarāmātmaprabhāve navai। yaṃ kūlaṃ kaṣaṇaṃ nyavārayadadhasphītānukampānidhiḥ ।। taṃ bhūyokhilavīraśaivamatabhūmandārabhūmiruhaṃ। vande'haṃ basaveśvaraṃ yavavatāṃ sadbrahmavidyāguruṃ ।। 9 ।।
cetasyākalayāmi taṃ prabhuvaraṃ śaivādhvanī(la)śramā। stomonmūlanacitsukhasudhādhārā prapāyattanam ।। muktyadhvapratikūladurmatatamastomopaṃhāvirbhavā drākācandamasaṃ yadallamakhyātaṃ guruṇāṃ gurum ।। 10 ।।
yo bhūmāvavatīrya canna basavaḥ śaivādhva dīkṣāguru। rdharmākāravṛṣādhināthasuyaṃratāryāti bhūmyākṛtam ।। ? līlāmānuṣabhāvataḥ kalakhalotsekāpahārotsukaṃ। kāryā kāryā vivekamāśudiśatādbrahmāmṛtādhārabhūḥ ।। 11 ।।
vikhyātān praṇamaḥ parārthamahimāstomairanekakramaiḥ। rvicchinnākhimuktisādhanakalatatpatiṣṭhāpanaiḥ ।। tattaddurmatanirmitāśayabharabhraṣṭānadṛṣṭārthadhī। vaiśadyena kṛtārthitān kalayatastān mañcaṇā gaṇān ।। 12 ।।
svādhīnā sarvavidyā tadapi nijapadādhīnamūlolādyavidyam। śāntaṃ sarveṣaṇāsuprathitaśivapadānveṣaṇārtheṣvaśāntam ।। cittāyattāṣṭasiddhiḥ paricitanijadrūpaddūṣprapañceṣṭasiddhiḥ। pādadvandvasya vāsyādgurubasavayatiḥ śreyase bhūyase syāt ।। 13 ।।
(astve) śrīnagarī dayāmbulaharī sarvottarādvaikarī। satyābjabhramarī sakhelanarī nṛtyaddṛmācāturī ।। vedodghoṣajharī viśeṣamukharī bhūtātmasampatkarī। bhavyāveṇupurī nisetiradharī bhūtadyupāramparī ।। 14 ।।
(p.4) [āste syāṃkaradīkṛtārikeḻadī bhūpānukampānadī]
āste syāṃkaradīkṛtārikeḻadī bhūpānukampānadī। jāniśrībasavakṣitīndravibhavapremānurūpodbhavaḥ ।। śairyaudāryakhalasvabhāvasukalasthairye ca hemācalaḥ। śreyo vāridhisomaśekharamahīpālaṃ svayaṃ nirmalaṃ ।। 15 ।।
nirvāṇābhidhayāmayantayalīlāvasurmānasaṃ। lokānugrahaṇāya nigrahakṛte dharmadviṣāmudvahan ।। sācivyaṃ kalayan amuṣyadharaṇī neturvṛṣādhīśvaraḥ। sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ mudaṃ vitanute śrīvīraśaivāgraṇīḥ ।। 16 ।।
nissīmātulavikramaḥ kavijanādīnārthadānakṛ * * * * * * * * * * * * * kṣubhakkalivyukramam ।। * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *। satye mānasi saṃkamaḥ sacivarāṇṇirvāṇamantrikramaḥ ।। 17 ।।
dhairyādārya yaśaḥ suśairyavibhavā gāmbhīrya mādhurya। mukhyāste vividhā guṇāḥ pratikalaṃ bhūyoti bhūmiṃ gatāḥ ।। sāmbādhīnaparasparaṃ varagaṇāstasminnamāṃtasvayaṃ। mūrtirbhūyavibhāti lokatapasā dhīrākhyayā ।। 18 ।।
prakhyāto bhadrappanāmā prabhuvaratilako bhūcchivācāraniṣṭha। stasyaivāsau tanūjaḥ paramaguṇaparo bhūtasudhīrnārapākhyaḥ ।। tadgarbhābdhau samudyatsuramaṇiśivaliṅgamantrī mahātmā। saddāmastemabhūmivarasuguṇamaṇiḥ premarbhūmirbalīyān ।। 19 ।।
kandarpāyatasundaraḥ karalasaddānaśriyā bandhuraḥ। kāntā śrīmadasindhuraḥ kalitasanmuktāvalī kandaraḥ ।। kalpāntogradurandharaḥ kapaṭeṣu sneyedarāmandaro। liṅgappaprabhusindhurāgamavidāṃkātsena gaṅgādharaḥ ।। 20 ।।
bā(ṇaste) kṛpaṇākare na vitaratyalpaṃ dviṣāṃ jīvanan। mitraṃ naiva nirīkṣaṇe vajati satkośālaye gopanaḥ ।। nikṣipya dviṣatāṃ tṛṇāni vadanemuṣṇantadīyāṃ śriyāṃ। netuṃ yuddhamupasthitaṃ yadi tadā śatruṃ samāśliṣyati ।। 21 ।।
liṅgappaprabhudhīrabhāphakakaranyastāsidhārā kuta। ssannaddhākhiladanti vājiradhasakpārātavidveṣiṇām ।। bheridvandvaninādasambhramabharaṃ dṛṣṭvāpi śatrormukham। nyastaṃ bālatruṇaṃ samīkṣya sabhayaṃ yuddhannivṛtto bhavat ।। 22 ।।
(p.5) dānaṃ śātravamitrayo vitanute kāryaṃ kramāt sampadam। taddhārā dāhati kvacittu hṛdayaṃ modāmṛtaiḥ siñcati ।। citraṃ śakranimajjanairvrajati taddaśyustu divyaṃ sukham। prāyeṇaiva satāṃ pravṛttisamataḥ śatrau ca mitre samam ।। 23 ।।
āsāte sukumāramārasadṛśākārā kumāropamau। dhīrodāraguṇakarau sucaritau dvau tau kumārau gurau ।। namrau rājajaṅgame pitari ca svīyeṣu sadṛkṣatā। vanyeṣūddhataśālibāliśajaneṣvātmārcitā vārcinau ।। 24 ।।
jāyānnirvāṇanāmā gurubasavayati khyātiśālīkamīyān। akkammākhyā prasiddhā mitaguṇabhaginī bhāgadheyā vivetau ।। tātā tītātivīryerjitasakalakalāśīlalīlāviloṭa। nirvoḍhānekamāḍhāvanipati hṛdayālīḍhakāryaikagūḍhā ।। 25 ।।
rājñasvājñānusārādatibalasukalo bajirāyādyaneka। kṣoṇīpālottamāṅgābharaṇacalacaṇobhīṣṭakāmeya kīrtiḥ ।। bhūmoddhāmābhirāmonmadhikasakalabhūpālapāchāha sākṣā। dīkṣādīkṣā vinodairjagati vijayate dhīrālaṅgappanetā ।। 26 ।।
śivojikūji pradayānunīyā vinīya pātsyāhamajījanahāśaḥ। pracaṇḍaderdaṇḍakaraṇḍapiṇḍa nairdaṇḍaya khaṇḍitabhūpamaṇḍalam ।। 27 ।।
nijāmanāmnaḥ pathito vilāsaḥ parābhavo yasya mahīpasantatiḥ ।। asāvajipremabhareṇa nūnaṃ liṅgappanetuḥ prapadāti mānam ।। 28 ।।
naktaṃ divaṃ vandanananditāvani maheśvarārādhanabhaktinaiṣṭikaṃ ।। seṣāṃ samīpe nivasantadājñayā vyākhyasi sama * * ṣaṭsthalānyapi ।। 29 ।।
paraḥ sahasraṃ caramūrttisaṅghe manonurūpaṃ vasanādi dānaiḥ ।। nijeṣṭaliṅgārcanayaunuvelāṃ svavīraśaivaṃ matamanvatiṣṭhan ।। 30 ।।
kṣetraṃ mahatkāpilasiddhamasti vāsormumokṣornilayo bubhukṣau ।। atītakāśī prathitaprakāsi kailāsasaṃkāśavinedaśāli ।। 31 ।।
vilasati vividhaśrīśaivatatvārthaniṣṭhai rgurubhirapi sametaṃ tatbudhaireva sarvaiḥ ।। gurapuramiti nāmnā svarthasiddhena bhāsva dgahanavakavanojaṃ bhātyasaṃkhyai gṛhaiśca ।। 32 ।।
bahiriha kaṭhināste pāśvayoḥ ketaśaṅghāḥ (p.6) viśadamadhurabhāvānāvivekena vedyā ।। gurava iti ihatyāstanvate dantabhaṅgam puruṣavadanaśīlo yo śrute bāhyavṛttaḥ ।। 33 ।।
jalanidhirativelaḥ kīrticandrodayena sphuṭaguruṣuramenaṃ dhīranirvāṇa netuḥ ।। namati bahulabhaktyā ghoṣayannātmamantraiḥ paricitanijajāyā tannadīdarśitādhvā ।। 34 ।।
lasadatanutaraṅgaśreṇīrūpaisvahastai ramalapṛthulaphenasphāramuktāphalaudyaiḥ ।। aharaharatibhaktyābhyarcati kṣetravaryaṃ manupaṭhatavinidraḥ paściśāsamudraḥ ।। 35 ।।
anyonyavaiṣamyabhareṇa naddhā vasantamukhyaṛsavaḥ ṣaḍaite ।। tyajanti vairaṃ śapathena tasmin pure gurorāśumitho milanti ।। 36 ।।
navaguruvāsī janmasāphalyameti vrajati kapilasiddhe śrīpadenaikabhāvam ।। phalamuditamaśeṣaṃ janmanaiva hetuḥ viśadayāti nūnaṃ tadguroḥ pādameti ।। 37 ।।
agaṇitasukṛtodyaiḥ prāpaṇīyaṃ janānāṃ jananamaraṇaduḥkhacchedakaṃ kṣetrametat ।। akhilasitapadānāṃ kāmadhenuḥ kavīnāṃ kalimalatamasaśvonmīlane koṭibhānuḥ ।।
lasati kapisiddhasvamirūpeṇa śambhuḥ sakalabhuvanabhāsvadagadheyairanantaiḥ ।। kalayati vṛṣanāthastasya nirvāṇamantrī pratidinamatisaṃkhyānutsavānutsukopi ।। 39 ।।
māghamāsi carite mahotsave śaivasaṅghamilite śivayoge ।। svasvaklṛptasiddhaye janāḥ deśadeśavasate rūpayātā ।। 40 ।।
nirvāṇamantrī sahapaurasaṅghai ranujñayā jñāpitavān svarājñaḥ ।। svetātapatraṃ caturaṅgasainyaṃ liṅgappanetā sahatatṣayātum ।। 41 ।।
kapilasiddhamuniṃ pratipadyate manasi bhaktibhareṇa namaskṛtiḥ ।। mukharikakhilatāntrikavaidikastuti mukhena sakhelamakurvata ।। 42 ।।
tadanu tasyanutasya mahotsave padasarojasarojasamarcane ।। na kalitaḥ kalitaḥ pratibandhaka stanubhṛtāṃnubhṛtāṃtarabhaktibhiḥ ।। 43 ।।
ayutakare phalādyabhisecane padaśiraḥstheta pūrvaviyannadī ।। * * * * * * * pratipadyataṃ śvaśuratāṃ nijaye * turardhati ।। 44 ।।
pracalitaḥ prativāsaramutsavaḥ pratikalaṃ nava eva padāmbuje ।।
(p.7) yaha pholiyo upalabdha nahīṃ hai।
(p.8) ākalpaṃ kalayatu te vaco vilāsaiḥ sākalpaṃ hṛdayasarojamasmadīyaṃ ।। 53 ।।
liṅgappanetāramamuṃ bubhutsuṃ lokopakārāya paraṃ pumarthaṃ ।। ālambya tatvaṃ madanugraheṇa maunappavidvanviti bodhayatvam ।। 54 ।।
tarkodarkatu te matī śruśivaco vyākhyāśu mīmāṃsakār। liṅgāṅgobhayasāmarasya kathane niḥśeṣavedāntakār ।। nānābhedasuśabdatatvakathane śrīpāṇinīyātmatā tmācīnāgatavīraśaivasamayavyākhyāsu tatvārthakār ।। 55 ।।
ityevamājñāṃ śirasā gṛhītvā liṅgappamantrī pratipāditārthaṃ ।। yayāmativyākṛtavānprasādai rudbhodhitāntaḥkaraṇaśvarāṇāṃ ।। 56 ।।
vijñāya tatvaṃ sakalāgamoktaṃ nivṛttasandehatayā samantrī ।। svaśre{ya}saṃ sarvahi śaṃkarārthaṃ vyajijñapajjaṃgamalingasaṅghe ।। 57 ।।
virācitanatirādau tatra liṅgappamantrī। carapadamupagṛhyāpūpujadbhaktipūrvam ।।
viśadamadhurabhāvairvākprasūnairanekaiḥ। sakalabhuvanalakṣmī bījavinyāsarūpaiḥ ।।
ātmābhirāme rāme hṛdayamalasarasyāpitaṃ brahmatasmā। deho devālayaḥ syācchrutiyugakuhare mantranikṣepamāsīt ।। putraśiṣyastvahamiti bhavatā satkatiliṅgatatve। santānāssaptaklṛptā prathulamahibhiste sadādau bhavadbhiḥ ।। 58 ।।
uṣā sātvikasantatiḥ pacalitāyārājanīsantatiḥ hetuḥ sātvikasantaterapi sutārāmādhikā ṣaḍvidhāḥ ।। lajjaṃ yuṣmadanugraheṇa tu mayā labdhā na śaivākṛtiḥ yasyā vāṅmayadarpaṇe pratiphālatyākalpamarthā ime ।। 60 ।।
ityevaṃ taṃ vadantaṃ prabhukulatilakaṃ satkṛtiṃ prārthayantaṃ। liṅgaṇpāmātyamete vṛtamatha guravaḥ pūritaṃ vāñchitārthaiḥ ।। (p.9) rdṛṣṭvā pāśvasthitaṃ māṃ bhuvanahitakṛte satkṛte rāvitārthaṃ pṛṣṭvā hastairurastyaiḥ śirasi karuṇayā sādhakaṃ nṛśāsuḥ ।। 61 ।।
śrīmanmaunappavidvannanupamadhiṣaṇāpaṃ prasādaistvayi syāt। muktāsatvena yerthā sakalajanahitā dhīraliṅgappanetuḥ ।। asmākaṃ śāsanena prathitasukṛtitāṃ yāntu sarvābhinandayā। yāvatkalpaṃ tvanalpaṃ kṛtirapi viduṣāṃ satpumarthaṃ prasūtām ।। 62 ।।
ityājñā jaṅgamānāṃ sapadivicalitāmanmubhādammubhābhu। tkāñcitkartuḥ śṛtiṃ sadvudhajanahṛdayagrahiṇīṃ yuktapuñjaiḥ ।। nānādharmābhidhānasmṛtinigamanirāmāśayaṃ kāmitādi। śrīmaddivyāgamārthāśayamabhidadhatīṃ vīraśaivānukūlāṃ ।। 63 ।।
śrīmajjaṅgamalocanadvaya kṛpālokāmṛtaiḥ pūritā। sattu śrīmahimālayārthahṛdayaprāntoditā bhāsvati ।। haṃsaiḥ ṣaṭsthalatīrthaśevivibudhailiṅgappamantrīraṇā। deṣā vāksaranurvīvekihṛdayasyākalpa mā siñcatu ।। 64 ।।
kailāsādi vaṭeṣu nṛtyasamaye brahmadi devairvṛte। śarvāṇīmupaveśya bhadrasadane nṛtyasya tāṃ sakṣiṇīṃ ।। vṛtto prakramanārthamudyamabhṛtaḥ śaṃkhāśṛtiṣvādarānaṃdyādye। rupanīyatāṃ sakṛdiyaṃ bhavyāmadīyākṛtiḥ ।। 65 ।।
।। iti śrīmadanādi pramathaparamparāgataṣaṭsthalajñānabedhakācāryavarya varagurubasavayati varalabdhavikāsena vīraśaivadīkṣāguru canna vīrasvāmikarakamalasañjātena maunappaviduṣākṛte vīraśaivācārakaustubhe kriyākāṇḍe sveṣṭadevatānatinetruvaṃśādi nirūpaṇaṃ nāma prathamaṃ prakaraṇam ।।
(p.10)
।। dvitīyaṃ prakaraṇam ।।
liṅgappanetaḥ śṛṇu sāvadhāna। sarvārthavidyā sakalārthasiddhiḥ ।। saṃprāpyate kṣiprakāraṃ śivopi। kaṭākṣavarvairabhisiñcaye svām ।। 1 ।।
parājitasurācārya buddhikauśalaśībhikā। pratyarthikālaṇḍābhaḥ bhujārddhisurabhūruhā ।। 2 ।।
liṅgappamantrin dhanyosi tvameva jagatī tale। yajjātā saralābuddhiḥ satkṛtiḥ śravaṇe tava ।। 3 ।।
tataste viśadākīrtismāspatyākalpamujvalā। vicāryeṇa vinā tatvaniṣkarṣaḥ syānna kasyacite ।। 4 ।।
tasmādvidyāṃ samabhyasya tadarthāṃśca vicārayet। sa ca vidyoddeśatantra sā vidyā vuddiśāmyahaṃ ।। 5 ।।
śṛtvā yathākramaṃ vidyāstadarthānyatra rocate। manastasminmate niṣṭhastākārdyamupayāsyasi ।। 6 ।।
aṅgāni vedāścatvāro mīmāṃsā nyāyavistaraḥ। purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca vidyahyetā caturdaśā ।। 7 ।।
śikṣākalpaṃ vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ jyotiṣaṃ tathā। chando vijitirityete ṣaḍaṅgo veda ucyate ।। 8 ।।
ṛkekaviṃśabhedāsyādyajurekaśataṃ mataṃ। sahastradhā sāmavedo navadhātharvaṇasmṛtaḥ ।। 9 ।।
pratipādyavibhedena vedāḥ kāṇḍadvayātmakaḥ। tatrādimaḥ karmakāṇḍo jñānakāṇḍaḥ samaṃ tataḥ ।। 10 ।।
pratiśākhaṃ parijñeya sacopaniṣadātmakaṃ। śrīrudrabṛhadāraṇya śvetāśvataramuṇḍakāḥ ।। 11 ।।
kaivalya kālāgnirudrau kaṭhavalli ca bāṣkaḻaḥ। haṃsaparamahaṃsaśca brahmanārāyaṇāvubhau ।। 12 ।।
rāmapūrvottarau tāpanīyo gopālaparvakau। pūrvottarau tāpanīyau nṛsiṃhākhyau tataḥ param ।। 13 ।।
pūrvāparau tāpanīyai veṅkaṭeśvarapūrvakau। pūrvottarau tāpanīyau kuritaśva tataḥ param ।। 14 ।।
yogaśikhā dīpaśikhā liṅgopaniṣadaḥ kramāt। kātyāyanyo brahmabandhurāruṇyāmṛtabindu * ।। 15 ।।
pañcabrahma ca jābālastejobinduśca maudgalaḥ। bodhāyanoya carce ca śravaṇaṃ ca parākramaḥ ।। 16 ।।
(p.11) prācyaśvaśaunakīyañca śivasaṃkalpameva ca । āśvalāyana maitreyanīya vājasaṇīyakam ।। 17 ।।
vedāntasārapravaṇavajrasocyaṃbatāstathā। sāṃkhyayasoyaṃ chāndogyaṃ bṛhadāraṇyamapyatha ।। 18 ।।
taitarīyaitareyaidvā praśvagarbhāṇubhāvapi। śarabhaśvātharvaśikhā nirlepaśvadicidambaram ।। 19 ।।
nirālambamahāvākya mahopaniṣadaḥ kramāt। pañcīkaraṇamapyevaṃ kathā śṛtirahasyakam ।। 20 ।।
suḥśiddhāntaśikhāmukhyā bhaktiyogādayo matāḥ। sattyasaṃkhyākopaniṣada uttarakāṇḍa ucyate ।। 21 ।।
pūrvottaravibhedena mīmāṃsā codvidhā matā। vaiśeṣikaṃ kāṇādaṃ nyāyaśāstraṃ dvidhā matam ।। 22 ।।
īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāṃ sarāvādirgururbudhaḥ। tasya śiṣyā mahāviṣṇussarvajñānamahodadhiḥ ।। 23 ।।
kasmadantaparijñāno brahmāsarvajagadguruḥ। sanatkumāro bhagavānbrahmaṇā śṛtavānidam ।। 24 ।।
sanatkumāraḥ sarvajñaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipyāyano muniḥ। avāptākhilavijñānastasmādetacchrutaṃ mayā ।। 25 ।।
adyāpi devalokosti śatakoṭipravistaraḥ। idaṃ lokahitārthāya saṃkṣiptaṃ paramarṣiṇā ।। 26 ।।
caturlakṣamidaṃ proktaṃ vyāsenādyutakarmaṇā। athāṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā tadarthābhiniveśitam ।। 27 ।।
bhāratākhyānamakarotssalakṣyantu saṃkhyayā। evaṃ sapādāḥ pañcaite lakṣyāḥ puṇyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।। 28 ।।
vālmīkena ca yatproktaṃ rāmopākhyānamuttamam। brahmaṇābhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ śatakoṭiprāvistaram ।। 29 ।।
adito nāradāyai tat tena bālmīkaye punaḥ। bālmīkinā ca lokeṣu prakāśitamanuttamam ।। 30 ।।
catuviṃśatisāhasraṃ dharmakāmārthamokṣadam। kramātpurāṇādināma kathayāmi samāsataḥ ।। 31 ।।
śṛṇutvaṃ bhaktiyuktena cetasā mantriśekhara। brāhmaṃ purāṇaṃ prathamaṃ pādmaṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca ।। 32 ।।
(p.12) śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ caiva bhaviṣyannāradīyakam। mārkeṇḍeyamatha jñeyaṃ brahmakaivartameva ca ।। 33 ।।
laiṅgaṃ kathā ca vārāhaṃ skāndaṃ vāmanameva ca। kaurmyaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍaṃ ca brahmaṇḍaṃ tadanantaraṃ ।। 34 ।।
aṣṭadaśapurāṇāni gaditāni yathākramam। aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu daśabhiḥ kathyate śivaḥ ।। 35 ।।
catubhirbhagavān viṣṇuḥ dvābhyāṃ brahmā tathā punaḥ। ekenāgnirathādityaḥ purāṇāni vibhāgaśaḥ ।। 36 ।।
śaivaṃ skāṃdaṃ tathā laiṅgyaṃ kaurmaṃ vāmanameva ca। vārāhaṃ ca bhaviṣyacca mātsyaṃ mārkaṇḍayameva ca ।। 37 ।।
brahmāṇḍaṃ ceti śaivāni purāṇāni mune daśa। nāradīyaṃ bhāgavatam gāruḍaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā ।। 38 ।।
vaiṣṇavāni purāṇāni catvārye tāni kumbhaja। brāhmayaṃ pādmaṃ vidheḥ pūṣṇo brahmakaivartameva ca ।। 39 ।।
āgneyamagneritthaṃ hi purāṇāni muneḥ kramāt। upapūrvāṇyatho vakṣye purāṇāni yathākramam ।। 40 ।।
ādyaṃ sanatkumāroktaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ yathottaram। sandhisaujñaṃ kumāreṇa kathitaṃ tadanantaram ।। 41 ।।
caturthaṃ śivadharmākhyaṃ purāṇaṃ nandineritam। tato dūrvāsā sā proktaṃ nāradīyaṃ tataḥ param ।। 42 ।।
kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva kathye usanaseritam। brahmāṇḍaṃ ca mahāpuṇyaṃ purāṇākhyaṃ tataḥ param ।। 43 ।।
tataḥ kālī purāṇākhyaṃ kālakaṇṭha ca nāmakaḥ। tato vāsiṣṭhalyaṅgākhyaṃ nāmnā māheśvaraṃ ca tat ।। 44 ।।
tataḥ sāmbapurāṇākhyaṃ sāvitramiti ceritam। parāśaroktamamalaṃ māricaṃ bhārgavābhidaṃ ।। 45 ।।
mahābhārataṃ yuktāni svetihāsāni kṛtsnaśaḥ। munīnāṃ kathayāmāsa sarveṣāṃ romaharṣaṇaḥ ।। 46 ।।
mitaṃ tadvārataṃ jñeyaṃ mapyaṣṭādaśa parvabhiḥ। ādi{parvaṃ} sabhāparvaṃ parvamāraṇyakaṃ tathā ।। 47 ।।
virāṭ parvantu vijñeyaṃ caturthaṃ tadanantaram। udyo(gaṃ) parvaṃ * * * bhīṣmaparvamataḥparam ।। 48 ।।
(p.13) saptamaṃ droṇaparvaṃ ca karṇaparvamathāṣṭamam। navama śalyaparvaṃ ca gadāyuddhamataḥ param ।। 49 ।।
ayuṣikaṃ tadanuproktaṃ garbhapātanameva ca। trayodaśantu strīparvaṃ pradhānamadakasya ca ।। 50 ।।
śāntiparvamathaproktaṃ āśvamedhikameva ca। svargārohaṇakaṃ parvaṃ harivaṃśastathaiva ca ।। 51 ।।
ityaṣṭādaśaparvāṇāṃ saṃkhyānaṃ manurabravīt। brāhmaṃ taddaśasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 52 ।।
pādmaṃ ca pañcapañcāśat sahasraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā। viṣṇvākhyamaṣṭasāhasraṃ śaivaṃ vadyaṣṭasaṃyutam ।। 53 ।।
hayagrīvaṃ brahmavidyā yatra vṛtravadhastathā। gāyatrī ca samārambhastadbhāgavatamucyate ।। 54 ।।
aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi bhaviṣyākhyaṃ taducyate। catuviṃśatsahasrāṇi nārade nābhibhāṣitam ।। 55 ।।
kathā dvādaśasāhasraṃ mārkeṇḍeyamihocyate। āgneyamaṣṭasāhasraṃ kaivartaṃ dvādaśaṃ smṛtam ।। 56 ।।
rudrasaṃkhyā tathā laiṅgyaṃ caturviṃśadvarāhakam। trayodaśasahasraṃ tu skāndaṃ caikaśatāvṛtam ।। 57 ।।
caturdaśasahasrāṇi vāmanaṃ ṣaṭsahasrakaṃ। kaurmaṃ caturdaśaivasyu māse ṣoḍaśa gāruḍe ।। 58 ।।
brahmāṇḍe dvādaśaivasya sahasrāṇi yathākramam। aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni saṃkṣipya sumahāyaśāḥ ।। 59 ।।
kṛtavān ślokarūpeṇa gaṇeśastāni cālikhat। purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstrebhyaḥ prathamaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam ।। 60 ।।
anantaraṃtu vaktrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ। aṣṭādaśaitā smṛtayaḥ krameṇa parinisrutāḥ ।। 61 ।।
vāsu pūrvo manuprokto bṛhaspatiranantaraḥ। dakṣanāmā trutīyasya dvaitamodhayamaiṅgirām ।। 62 ।।
yogīśvarapracetāśca śāyātapaparāśarau। saṃhartośamasā śaṃkha likhitāvatrireva ca ।। 63 ।।
viṣṇvāpastambahārīta dharmaśāstraprarvartakāḥ। aṣṭadaśopasmṛtayastannāmā paricihnitāḥ ।। 67 ।।
(p.14) evaṃ caturdaśākhyātā vidyā śivavinirmitā। etāsāmapi vidyānāmupaṣṭambhatayā punaḥ ।। 68 ।।
sākṣācchivamukhādgītā aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃhikāḥ। aṣṭāviṃśatidhā bhiṃnaṃ śaivasiddhāntasattamam ।। 69 ।।
siddhāntaṃ dvividhaṃ jñeyaṃ śaivaṃ raudramiti sthitiḥ। daśadhā śivabhedāsyuḥ raudramaṣṭādaśoditāḥ ।। 70 ।।
kāmikādyā vātulāntāḥ śivenoktāḥ śivāgamāḥ। āgatā śivavaktrabhyo dattāśca girijāmukham ।। 71 ।।
matāśca vāmadevenetyāgamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।। tripadārtha catuṣpādaṃ mahātantraṃ jagatpatiḥ ।। 72 ।।
proktavān himavatputrebhya dharmamokṣārthasādhanam। sūkṣmāgamajñānapāde śṛtamāgamalakṣaṇam ।। 73 ।।
sarvabhūtakṣaye sarvalokānāṃ vilaye sati। tatprītyai vistvatastvaṣṭavāgamāḥ parikīrtitāḥ ।। 74 ।।
caturdhāyaṃ vibhinnosau jñānayogakriyātmakāḥ। kriyākhyayānti me nāpi jñeyaḥ pādacatuṣṭayam ।। 75 ।।
।। devyuvāca ।।
jñānavādādikaṃ spaṣṭaṃ mayi prītyā kuru prabho ।।
śrīśivaḥ ।।
śrīmad jñānajñānapādaṃ śānmadogaṃ yogapāttataḥ ।। 76 ।।
kriyāmalliṅgadhṛtyādi devasyālayanirmitiḥ। matpūjāmatparācāro manmantrajapalakṣaṇam ।। 77 ।।
caryāpādamimaṃ prāha rāgamārthavivekinaḥ। kāmikaṃ yogajaṃ cintyam kāraṇaṃ tvajitaṃ tathā ।। 78 ।।
dīptasūkṣmaṃ sahasraṃ ca pyaṃśumān suprabhedakaḥ। vijayaṃ caiva niśvāsaṃ svāyaṃbhuvamayānalam ।। 79 ।।
viriñca rauravaṃ veti makuṭaṃ vimalaṃ tathā। candrajñānaṃ bimvaṃ ca prodgītaṃ lalitaṃ tathā ।। 80 ।।
siddhasaṃtānaśarvoktau pārameśvarameva ca। kiraṇaṃ vātulaṃ caitā aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃhitāḥ ।। 81 ।।
sadyojātamukhājjātāḥ pañcādyāḥ kāmikādayaḥ। vāmadevamukhājjātāḥ dīptādyāḥ pañcasaṃhitāḥ ।। 82 ।।
aghoravaktrā{du}dbhūtāḥ pañcātho vijayādayaḥ। pañcavaktrāthasaṃbhūtāḥ pañcātho rauravādayaḥ ।। 83 ।।
(p.15) īśānavadanājjātāḥ prodgītādyasaṃhitāḥ। śaivānāṃ daśabhedānāṃ śotārastu strayaḥ strayaḥ ।। 84 ।।
raudrāṣṭa(śa) bhedānāṃ dvau dvau siddhau matā budhaiḥ। maheśātpraṇavaḥ prāptaḥ praṇavā trikalasmṛtaḥ ।। 85 ।।
trikalācca haraḥ prāptaḥ śotāraḥ kāmikaḥ smṛteḥ। śuddho bhasmavibhūtiśca śrotāro yogajasmṛteḥ ।। 86 ।।
kāraṇaṃ sarvarudraśca kāraṇajñaḥ prajāpatiḥ। śrotārastvajitasyāsya suśivākhya śivācchrutāḥ ।। 87 ।।
dīptaboddhārañaśaśca trimūrtiśvahutāśanaḥ। sūkṣmo vaiśravaṇasūkṣmatantrajñaśca prabhañjanaḥ ।। 88 ।।
kāloramaśca dharmaśca sahasrāgamakovidāḥ ।। aṃśurūgo saveśvaiva śrotāraṃśumatastrayaḥ ।। 89 ।।
boddhāraḥ suprabhedasya deveśo vighnarāṭ śaśī ।। boddhāraḥ śivabhedānāṃ daśānāṃ triṃśadīritāḥ ।। 90 ।।
anādiḥ parameśaśca śrotārau vijayaḥ śatau ।। daśārno girijā jñeyai niḥśvāsajñau vicakṣaṇai ।। 91 ।।
svāyambhuvajñau nidhanapadmedbhūtau yathākramam ।। bauddhārau vimalaṃ tantraṃ vāmābhyo hyagnisaujñakāḥ ।। 92 ।।
jñeyaivīrākhyatantrajñau kramādetāsu śobhanau। rauravāgamaśrotārau nandi * * * * * * ।। śivākhyaśca mahādevau makuṭāgamakovidau ।। 93 ।।
sarvātmadevāvimalaśrotāro vīrabhadrakaḥ। candrajñānasya boddhāravanantaśca bṛhaspatiḥ ।। 94 ।।
bimbāgamasya boddhāraḥ praśāntaśca dadhīcakaḥ। prodgītatantraboddhārau śūlīkavacanāmakaḥ ।। 95 ।।
jñātārau lalitaṃ tantraṃ layākhye rudrabhairavaḥ। boddhārau śuddhatantraśca vīraścandīśvaraśca tau ।। 96 ।।
santānatantraṃ boddhārau śivaniṣṭhāṃ savāhanaḥ। somadevo nṛsiṃhaśca śarvoktaṃ tantramaśritau ।। 97 ।।
śrīdevī coddhanā proktau jñātārau pārameśvarau। devaḥ pitā ca saṃvardhā jñātārau kiraṇāgamaṃ ।। 98 ।।
śiraścātha mahākālo jñātārau vātulāgamam। (p.16) aṣṭāviṃśati tantrāṇāṃ pṛthagbhedo nigadyate ।। 99 ।।
saptārcirbhūtaṣaḍi्bhamunijalanidhibhirnanditāṃśudigbhiḥ। tigmārcisomabhāgairdvirradahutavahairyugmakāmārtunetraiḥ ।। paścātsākaṃkalābhirmunidivasakalābhirvahninābdhaiśca dhāto। rvāṇairlokaissarandhraistapanasaguṇitairāgamānāṃ vibhedāḥ ।। 100 ।।
{āgamabhedāḥ}
uttaraṃ nārasiṃhaśca bhairavottarameva ca। kāmikasya trayobhedāḥ kīrtitāstantrakovidaiḥ ।। 101 ।।
vīṇā śivottaraṃ tantraṃ sūtasaṃtānasāragau। ātmayogamiti khyātaṃ pañcadhā yogajasya ca ।। 102 ।।
pāpanāśaṃ parodbhūtaṃ suciṃtyaṃ sukhāmamṛte। vāmākhyacintyatantrasya bhedāsyu ṣaṭ smṛtā budhaiḥ ।। 103 ।।
mahendrapāvakaṃ dairghyam māraṇaṃ bhīmasaṃhitā। vidveṣaṃ kāraṇaṃ ceti saptadhā kāraṇaṃ smṛtam ।। 104 ।।
pārvatīśaṃ parodbhūtaṃ prabhūtaṃ padmasaṃhitā। ajitasya ca catubhedāḥ kīrtitāstantrapāragaiḥ ।।
ameyamakṣayaṃ cājamānandamamitaujasaḥ। mādhavoddhavamatsākhye āsaṃkhaṃ hi tatodbhavaḥ ।। 105 ।।
dīptasya navabhedāsyu sūkṣmasya tvekabhedakam। atītamamalaṃ śuddhamaprameyaṃ subodhakam ।। 106 ।।
jātibhedaṃ bodhatantramalaṅkāraprabodhakaṃ। sahasrākhyatantrasya bhedāsyurdaśadhā tathā ।। 107 ।।
kāśyapaṃ vāsavaṃ brāhmaṃ gaitamaṃ nīlalohitaṃ। vidyāpurāṇaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ bhūtatantraṃ mahendrakam ।। 108 ।।
ātmālaṃṅkāramīśānottaraṃ prakaraṇaṃ tviti। dvādaśāṃśumato bhedā suprabhedamabhedakam ।। 110 ।।
mṛtyunāśaṃ bhavaṃ saumyaṃ kaubereśamadodbhavam। aghoraṃ ca mahāghoraṃ vijaye vimaloṣṭadhā ।। 111 ।।
niśvāsaṃ ghoraniśvāsaṃ niśvāsanayanaṃ sudhā। niśvāsottarakūle ca niśvāsavadanodayaṃ ।। 112 ।।
niśvāsakarikābhedā niśvāsasyāṣṭabhedakaḥ। prajāpatimataṃ padmaṃ svāyambhuvāmiti tridhā ।। 113 ।।
ājñeyaṃ vyomasaṃjñe ca dvidhā cāgneyamāsthitam। prasvaraṃ phullanayanaṃ prabodhaṃ bodhabodhakam ।। 114 ।।
(p.17) amohaṃ mohasamaya śakaṭaṃ śākaṭāyakam। vilekhanaṃ ca vimalam halaṃ bhadraṃ ca vīrakam ।। 115 ।।
bhedāsyurvīratantrasya kīrtitāste trayodaśā। kālākhyaṃ kāladahanaṃ rauravaṃ rauravottaram ।। 116 ।।
mahākālamatāciṃtye ṣaḍbhedā rauravasya ca। makuṭasya dvidhābhedo makuṭaṃ makuṭottaram ।। 117 ।।
alaṅkṛtaṃ bhīmaraudramaṭṭahāsaṃ vṛṣodaram। ārevatamatikrāntaṃ vṛṣapiṅgaṃ subhadrakam ।। 118 ।।
ākrāntamarcitaṃ bhogamanantākhyaṃ ca māraṇam ।। vṛṣaguhyaṃ sudattaṃ ca vimalasya tu ṣoḍaśa ।। 119 ।।
ekapādapurāṇaṃ ca sthāṇvākhyaṃ nandikeśvaram। śrīmukhaṃ śaṃkaraproktaṃ vāyavyaṃ śivaśāsanam ।। 120 ।।
śivabhadraṃ kalpabhedaṃ vāraṇaṃ śivasekharaṃ। devī mataṃ sthiravyāptaṃ candrajñāne caturdaśa ।। 121 ।।
ardhālaṅkāramaiśānaṃ pratibimbamayogajam। kauṭakaṃ kaṭinīrañca kuṭṭimaṃ paṭṭaśekharam ।। 122 ।।
mahāvidyā mahāsāraṃ tulāpratyayanairute। caturmukhastalākoṭi saṃstobhamiti kīrtitāḥ ।।23 ।।
mukhaṃ bimbasya tantrasya bhedāḥ pañcadaśaḥ kramāt। śaivajñānaṃ ca kavacaṃ vārāhaṃ piṅgalāmakam ।। 124 ।।
kālajñānaṃ dhanurvedamāyurvedaṃ dhanurdharam। vijñānamakuśaṃ gītamātodyaṃ bharataṃ tathā ।। 125 ।।
pāśaṃ bandhaṃ daṇḍadharaṃ saptadaṃṣṭramiti kramāt। prodgītanāma tantrasya bhedāḥ ṣoḍaśa kīrtitāḥ ।। 126 ।।
nīlottaraṃ ca lalitaṃ komalaṃ lalitaṃ tathā। śālāmauṃsalasaṃsāra saṅgrahaṃ śaśimaṇḍalam ।। 127 ।।
bhedāḥ siddhākhyatantrasya caturdhā kīrtitā budhaiḥ। amaṃreśaṃ surādhyakṣaṃ liṅgādhyakṣamasaṃkhyakam ।। 128 ।।
anilaṃ śāṃkaraṃ dvandvam santāne saptadhā mataḥ। īśānaṃ śivadharmaṃ ca śivadhamottaraṃ tathā ।। 129 ।।
devī praṇīta saumyasya śarvoktā pañcadhā smṛtāḥ। samānyasākṣiṇaṃ haṃsaṃ mataṅgaṃ suprayogakam ।। 130 ।।
(p.18) padmākhyaṃ pauṣkaraṃ bhedāssaptadhā pārameśvare। viśvātmakaṃ śivadvandvaṃ kālajñānaṃ mahāmukham ।। 131 ।।
śarvaṃ sarvātmakaṃ śuddhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rudraṃ parohitaṃ। vātulottaramityete vātule dvādaśa smṛtāḥ ।। 132 ।।
ityetāssaṃhitāssarva aṣṭādhikaśatadvayam। śaivānāmaṣṭapañcāśadraudrāṇāmiti bhedakāḥ ।। rudrāṣṭādaśabhedānāṃ śataṃ sārdhamudāhṛtam ।। 133 ।।
vaināyakaṃ tathā śāktaṃ kapālo sārameva ca। vaiṣṇavaṃ buddhaśaivaṃ ca ṣaḍdarśanamitīritam ।। 134 ।।
pādaṃ vaināyakaṃ viṃdyātkaṭaśāktaṃ vidurbudhāḥ। kāpālaṃ jaṭharaṃ proktaṃ vakṣasthānantu sārakam ।। 135 ।।
skandau tathā vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā śaivaṃ śirasmṛtam। ṣaḍdarśanamamāṅgānāṃ ṣaṭsthānaṃ parikīrtitam ।। 136 ।।
gachedyanaṃ ca dūṣyaṃ ca himamāṅgaṃ sarvapāvanam। dūṣaṇachedane dehi mamāṅgasya satādṛśaḥ ।। 137 ।।
ātatayi samāloke madbhaktopi na śaivavit। granthasaṃkhyāmāgamānāṃ vaidikānantu varṇaye ।। 138 ।।
parārdhalakṣopi ca lakṣakoṭi। tato yutaṃ vainiyutaṃ ca padmaṃ ।। śaṃkheṣu lakṣenalakoṭiyugme। kāṭīsahārthena tu koṭireka ।। 139 ।।
nadīsahasraṃ niyutārbudedho। koṭitrilakṣānalakoṭiyaśca ।। sahasralakṣatritaye tathā ca। sahasramardhena ca koṭireka ।। 140 ।।
sahasraṣaṭkaṃ ca tathopi lakṣam। caṇḍāṃśulakṣaṃ śatakoṭilakṣam ।। divyāgamānāṃ śivarudrakānām। granthasya saṃkhyā gaditā krameṇa ।। 141 ।।
śambaṃ parārdhaṃ kamalārbudedho। vyomārkakoṭirgajasindhulakṣam ।। bhūtāgnisāhasramitīritātha। (p.19) granthasya saṃkhyā gaditā krameṇa ।। 142 ।।
ekadaśaśatasahasrāyuta। lakṣaprayutakoṭayaḥ kramaśaḥ ।। arbudavṛnde kharvonikharva। mahāpadmakaṃ bhavarastasmāt ।। 143 ।।
jaladhiścāntyaṃ madhyaṃ। * * * * * * * ।। * * * * * * * । * * * * * * * ।। 144 ।।
athāvedikatantrāṇi yāriśaḥ santu bhūtale। mahāmāyā śambaraṃ ca yoginijālaśaṃvaram ।। 145 ।।
tatra śambaraṃ caiva bhairavāṣṭakameva ca। candrajñānaṃ vāsukaṃ ca mahāsaṃmohanaṃ tathā ।। 146 ।।
mahocchuṣkaṃ mahādeva vātulaṃ vātulottaram। hṛdbhedamātmabhedaṃ ca guhyatantraṃ ca kāmikam ।। 147 ।।
kalāsoma kalāsāraṃ tathānya kubjakāmakam। mayottaraṃ ca vīṇākhyaṃ krokalaṃ krokalottaram ।। 148 ।।
pañcāmṛtaṃ rūpabhedaṃ bhūtoddāmarameva ca। kalāsāraṃ kuloddīśaṃ kulacūḍāmaṇistathā ।। 149 ।।
sarvajñānottaraṃ caiva mahāneva mataṃ tathā। mahālakṣmīmataṃ caiva siddhayogīśvarī mataṃ ।। 150 ।।
kurūpikāmataṃ caiva rūpikāmatameva ca। sarvavīramatañcaiva vimalāmatamuttamam ।। 151 ।।
pūrvapaścimadākṣiṇyamuttaraṃ ca niruttaram। tatra vaiśeyakaṃ jñeyaṃ vīrayogaṃ tataḥ param ।। 152 ।।
aruṇeśaṃ mohaneśaṃ viśuddheśvarameva ca। sarvavīramataṃ caiva vimalāmatamuttamam ।। 153 ।।
evametāni tantrāṇi tathānyānyapi bhūriśaḥ। atha vaiṣṇavatantrāṇi aṣṭādaśaśatāni ca ।। 154 ।।
tānyekaśatasaṃkhyāyāṃ pādmaṃ pādmodbhavaṃ matam।
(māyāvaibhava nalakūbara)
trailokyamohanaṃ viṣṇu tilekaṃ kanakāhvayam ।। 155 ।।
(p.20) nāradīyaṃ lānadīyaṃ vāsiṣṭhaṃ puṣkalāhvayam। sanatkumāraṃ sanakaṃ satyākhyaṃ viśvasaṃhitam ।। 156 ।।
sānandākhyaṃ mahipraśnaṃ strīpraśnaṃ puruṣottamam। mahendrasaṃhitāvacya praśnātyantakasāgaram ।। 157 ।। ?
vāsiṣṭhaṃ sātvataṃ rejo draviṇaṃ śrīkarāhvayaṃ। sāṃvartaviṣṇusadbhāvaṃ siddhāntaṃ viṣṇupūrvakam ।। 158 ।।
viṣṇutatvaṃ ca kaumāraṃ rahasyaṃ viṣṇupūrvakaṃ। viṣṇuvaibhavikaṃ tāraṃ saumyamīśānasaṃhitā ।। 159 ।।
pū * tantraṃ śaunakīyaṃ mārīcaṃ dakṣasaṃhitā ।। aupendraṃ yogahṛdayaṃ hārītaṃ pārameśvaram ।। 160 ।।
ātreyaṃ mandiraṃ viṣvaksenamauṃśasāṃhvayam। vaihāyasaṃ vihangedraṃ hārṣaṃ paramapauruṣam ।। 161 ।।
yājñavalkyaṃ gautamīyaṃ paulastyaṃ śākalāhṛyaṃ। jñānākhyaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ ca yāmyaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ।। 162 ।।
pārāśaryaṃ ca jābālaṃ kāpālaṃ vāmanāhvayam। dayottaraṃ bārhaspatyaṃ jaiminaṃ sātvatāhvayam ।। 163 ।।
kātyāyanīyaṃ vālmīkaṃ maupagāyanasaṃhitā। hiraṇyagarbhamāgastyaṃ kārṣṭyaṃ bodhāyanāhvayaṃ ।। 164 ।।
bhāradvājaṃ nārasiṃhaṃ gargyamuttamapūrvakam। śārātapāñcāngīrasaṃ kāsyapaṃ paiṅgalāhvayaṃ ।। 165 ।।
trailokyamohanaṃ yoga nāradīyaṃ ca vāraṇaṃ। kṛṣṇacāmaramajñeyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyasya sangraham ।। 166 ।।
mahāsanatkumārākhyaṃ vyāsākhyaṃ viṣṇusaṃhitā। mārkaṇḍeyaṃ pārśadaṃ ca brāhmaṃ narakasaṃhitā ।। 167 ।।
saṃvādaḥ kadraśutrābhyamumāmaheśvarāhvayam। dattātreyaṃ ca śarvākhyaṃ vyāsākhyamabhirāhvayam ।। 168 ।।
saṃkarṣaṇākhyaṃ pradyumnaṃ vāmanaṃ kalkarāghavau। prācetasākhyamityetacchrutamekottaraṃ śatam ।। 169 ।।
etāni tantranāmāni pūrvairuktānyanukramāt। evamekottaraṃ śatam vaiṣṇavaṃ tantramucyate ।। 170 ।।
catuṣaṣṭiśaivatantrāṇyānyānyapyatha bhūriśaḥ। vedānurodhatantrāṇāṃ prāmāṇyamitarāṇi tu ।। 171 ।।
(p.21) avaidikaparāṇyeva sadṛśau nigamāgamau। vedasiddhāntayoraikyamekārthaḥ pratipādanāt ।।। 172 ।।
prāmāṇyaṃ sadṛśaṃ jñeyaṃ paṇḍitairetayoḥ sadā। athavā śivaniśvāsaśṛtibhyaste śivāgamāḥ ।। 173 ।।
adhikā śivavaktrebhyaḥ sākṣādeva vinirgatāḥ। parasparāviruddhārthāḥ śivoktā nigamāgamāḥ ।। 174 ।।
alpabuddhi{bhikhyonya} virodhaḥ parikalpate। nigamānāmāgamānāṃ paramāptopadeśakāḥ ।। 175 ।।
prāmāṇyamaviśeṣeṇa jñātavyaṃ tatvadarśibhiḥ। nararṣidevadṛhiṇaviṣṇurudrādyudīritam ।। 176 ।।
ekottaramutkarṣa pūrva pūrva prabodhakam।
iti kriyāsāramukhya grantheṣu pratipādyate ।।
।। iti śrīvīraśaivācārakaustubhe kriyākāṇḍe vaidikāvaidika vidyodyeśanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ prakaraṇam ।।
।। tṛtīyaṃ prakaraṇam ।।
maunappavidvannurddiṣṭavidyoddeśāt parātparam। tasmāt carācaraṃ viśvaṃ prādurbhavati tadvada ।। 1 ।।
liṅgappamantrimūrdhanya vidvatkāmikakalpa *। bhavatsṛṣṭaṃ {viśeṣeṇa} provyate śṛṇu satprabho ।।
īśānasarvavidyānāṃ sarāvādi gururbudhāḥ। ityādibhyaḥ pramāṇebhyaḥ śivo vidyādhipaḥ smṛtaḥ ।। 3 ।।
itthaṃ carācaraṃ viśvamāvirbhavati tacchruṇu। śrīmānmahānādi bhaktaḥ svaprakāśo dvitīyakaḥ ।।4 ।।
yo'sau brahmeti saṃproktaḥ śivatattvārthavedibhiḥ। tasmādyastu prādurabhūtsanirañjanajaṅgamaḥ ।। 5 ।।
tacchikhāyāṃ śūnyaliṅgaṃ sañjātaṃ viśvakāraṇaṃ। tasmānniṣkalaliṃgaṃ tu saṃjātaṃ svecchayā punaḥ ।। 6 ।।
tasmāttu niṣkalālliṃgānmahāliṃgamabhūtsvayaṃ। tasmātpraṇavaliṃgaṃ tu sṛṣṭinmukhamajāyata ।। 7 ।।
etasmācchivatatvantu sādākhyaṃ ca tato bhavet। tasmānmaheśvaro jātaḥ tasmādrudrasamudbhavaḥ ।। 8 ।।
(p.22) tasmājjanārdano jātaḥ tasmājjātaḥ pitāmahaḥ। pitāmahātsamudbhūtaṃ jagadetaccarācaram ।। 9 ।।
ādāvanādibhaktasya lakṣaṇaṃ vadmite kramāt। yadisti tatparaṃ brahma svayaṃ nādinbhavedyadaḥ ।। 10 ।।
tasmādanādibhaktoyamityuktastatvavedibhiḥ। liṃgajaṃgama ādiśyādbhaktaścānādirūpakaḥ ।। 11 ।।
liṃgaliṃgamiti proktaṃ prāṇo jaṃgama ucyate। liṃgajaṃgamayoraikya svarūpo bhakta ucyate ।। 12 ।।
jaṃgamo liṃgarūpasyālliṃgaṃ jaṃgamarūpakam। liṃgajaṃgamasaṃyogonādibhaktasya lakṣaṇam ।। 13 ।।
liṃgajaṃgamabhaktāśca strayastvekasvarūpakāḥ। dehaprāṇāstathā jāte tyāgamānvayanirṇayaḥ ।। 14 ।।
nityaṃ pūrṇaṃ cidānandaṃ sadrūpaṃ brahmakīrtitam। ye devākhaṇḍarūpaṃ syādetadbhaktasya lakṣaṇam ।। 15 ।।
gururliṃgaṃ caraśeṣaḥ pādāmbha * karūpakam। alaghuyadbrahadvastu paripūrṇaṃ gurusmṛtam ।। 16 ।।
dṛśyaṃ līnaṃ jagadyasmin tannityaṃ liṃgamucyate। svayaṃ prakāśarūpaśca saccijjaṃgama iṣyate ।। 17 ।।
saukhyaṃ śataguṇādhikyaṃ prasādo'yaṃ viśiṣyate। eteṣāṃ surasāpūraiḥ svarasī kṛtacidvidham ।। 18 ।।
etatpādodakaṃ viṃdhyā tadrūpo bhakta ucyate। ācāro gurusambaṃdho niṣṭhā talliṃgasaṃyatā ।। 19 ।।
sujñānaṃ jaṃgamaṃścaiva pratyakṣaṃ ca prasādakaḥ। tattadekarasaṃcaiva pādodakamidaṃ śṛṇu ।। 20 ।।
idaṃ cānādibhaktasya pañcācārasvarūpakam। tasya rūpāntareṇaiva ṣaḍvidhācāralakṣaṇam ।। 21 ।।
akhaṇḍapūrṇaṃ nityaṃ ca citprakāśaṃ prakīrtitam ।। parānandaṃ cidrasaṃ ca ṣaḍvidhaṃ bhaktalakṣaṇam ।। 22 ।।
pūrṇaṃ nityaṃ citprakāśaṃ parānandaṃ ca cidrasam। śṛṇu devi hyakaṇḍatvaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ liṃgalakṣaṇam ।। 23 ।।
citprakāśaṃ pūrṇanityaṃ paramānandacidrasam। akhaṇḍatvaṃ mahādevi ṣaḍvidhaṃ caralakṣaṇam ।। 24 ।।
(p.23) paramānanda pūrṇe ca nityatvaṃ citprakāśakam। cidrasaṃ syādakhaṇḍatvaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ śeṣalakṣaṇam ।। 25 ।।
sadrasaṃ pūrṇamitye ca citprakāśaṃ mama priye। parānandamakhaṇḍatvaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ tīrthalakṣaṇam ।। 26 ।।
idaṃ tasya pṛthaṅmiśraṣaḍvidhācāralakṣaṇam। gururliṃgaṃ caraścaiva prasādaḥ pādavāri ca ।। 27 ।।
bhūtirudrākṣamantrāśca bhaktāṃgamiti kathyate। bhūtiḥ parānubhūtirhi snānaṃ tatrāvagāhanam ।। 28 ।।
tripuṇḍraṃ triguṇābhāvo hyaliṃga liṃgameva tat। mano mukhāni cākṣāṇi rudrākṣāṇi vidhāya vai ।। 29 ।।
caturdaśakramāddhāryāṇyetadrudrākṣadhāraṇam। pañcaṣaḍvidhatatvāṇi na kṣarante samāsataḥ ।। 30 ।।
yasyāṃ pañcākṣarī sā ca svayameva ṣaḍakṣarī। ityaṣṭāvaraṇaṃ tasya tatvaṣṭakamudīritam ।। 31 ।।
ācārapañcakaṃ rūpaṣaṭkamāvaraṇāṣṭakam। tanvaṣṭakaṃ svasvarūpādvibhinnaṃ tasya vibhrataḥ ।। 32 ।।
bhavedanādibhaktasya svarūpamidameva hi। sarvakāraṇarūpaṃ ca sarvatatva paraṃ tathā ।। 33 ।।
anādibhaktarūpantu tavoditamidaṃ śṛṇu ।।
bhaktonirūḍhe nijabhāvarūpiṇe। nirāśrayānandanivāsadāyinī ।। nirdehake nirviṣaye nirindriye। niṣkevale nityapade virājite ।। 34 ।।
idaṃ cānādibhaktasya svarūpaṃ parikīrtitam। tasya kāraṇamūrtīnāmāśrayatvamathocyate ।। 35 ।।
paścime'nādibhaktasya hṛdi bhāti nirañjanaḥ। śikhāyāṃ śūnyaliṃgantu brahmarandhre cidaṃbaram ।। 36 ।।
bhrūmadhye śivabhakte ca kaṇṭhe pañcaiva śaktayaḥ। kalāpañcakamevaṃ syānmukhapañcameva ca ।। 37 ।।
sādakhyapañcakaṃ nādapañcakaṃ mūrtipañcakam। anāhate tasya bhāti ceśvarāṣṭakameva ca ।। 38 ।।
maṇipūrakacakrasya pañcaviṃśatimūrtayaḥ। (p.24) svādhiṣṭhāne tasya caika daśarudrāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ।। 39 ।।
tasyādhāre virāḍantaryāmihairaṇyagarbhakāḥ। brahmaṇo navabhedaśca viṣṇośca daśamūrtayaḥ ।। 40 ।।
evaṃ hyanādibhaktasya cidgarbhāṇḍanivāsinaḥ। tyasīti mūrvayaḥ proktā niyamyā viśvayonayaḥ ।। 41 ।।
evaṃ hyanādibhaktasya lakṣaṇaṃ parikīrtitam। bhaktasya paścimahṛdi sthitoyonādi jaṃgamaḥ ।। 42 ।।
tasya svarūpamadhunā samāsena prakāśyate। paśvādibhaktasya hṛcci pradmāṃtare sadā * * ।। 43 ।।
cinmaṇḍalaśrayopeta praṇavāsanamadhyagaḥ। ninañcanastatpraṇava svarūpotra nigadyate ।। 44 ।।
nirākṛtaṃ rañjanaṃ yanmāyāmohavijṛmbhitam। yena svarūpasiddhena sabhaveddhi nirañjanaḥ ।। 45 ।।
tadeva niṣkalaṃ brahma nirvikalpaṃ nirañjanaṃ। nirnāmaṃ niravagrahaṃ niraśanaṃ niṣkāraṇam ।। 46 ।।
niḥsaṃgaṃ nirupādhikaṃ nirupamaṃ niṣkriyam। niścalaṃ niṣpuṇyaṃ niranugrahaṃ niradhikam ।।
nirvāsanaṃ nirvahaṃ nirvedyaṃ nirayaṃ। nirañjanapadaṃ caitadbhaje tajjaṃgam ।। 47 ।।
adyantarahitaṃ jyotiranādiprabhuravyayaḥ। anādeśo hyayaknaśca jaṃgamasyānniraṃjanaḥ ।। 48 ।।
idaṃ tasya nirālambasvarūpaṃ samudīritam। caturvedāśca tadgarbhaṃ purāṇaṃ tasya madhyamaṃ ।। 49 ।।
yogino munayaḥ sarve jaṃgamāṃdhi samaśritāḥ। tasya dehe samastāni bhuvanāni caturdaśa ।। 50 ।।
pādayoratalaṃ viṃdhyātpādordhvaṃ vitalaṃ tathā। janghayessutalaṃ jñeyaṃ jānudeśe mahātalaṃ ।। 51 ।।
talātalaṃ tadurvośca guhyasthāne rasātalam। kaṭibandhe tu pātālaṃ saptalokāḥ samīritāḥ ।। 52 ।।
bhūlokomabhimadhye tu bhuvarlokasya codare। suvarlokastu hṛdaye janarlokastu kandhare ।। 53 ।।
(p.25) tālveśyāpi tato lokassatvaloko lalāṭake। maharlokastasya mūrdhni caturdaśa samīritāḥ ।। 54 ।।
brahmāṃḍaṃ mukuṭaṃ tasya vadanaṃ gaganaṃ śruṇu। tadbāhavo diśassarvā netre caṃdradivākarau ।। 55 ।।
śarīraṃ vyomarupaṃ ca vitalaṃ pādapaṃkajam। karasthale śūnyaliṃgaṃ meghāḥ sarve jaṭāḥ śrutāḥ ।। 56 ।।
caṃdrajyotsnā vibhūtiśca vedāḥ sarve kriyā mayāḥ। nakṣatrāṇi ca puṣpāṇi rudrākṣaḥ kulaparvatāḥ ।। 57 ।।
